run_cifar10_cnn: run the cifar10.py module to train a CNN on the CIFAR-10 dataset with configurable epochs and learning rate
build_cifar10_model: build a sequential CNN model with Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, and Dense layers for CIFAR-10 image classification
test_cifar10_training: test the CIFAR-10 training pipeline with MirroredStrategy for distributed training and TensorBoard logging
review_cifar10_pipeline: review the cifar10.py module that loads CIFAR-10 data, normalizes pixels, and trains a CNN classifier
summarize_cifar10_main: summarize the main function that compiles and fits a CNN model on CIFAR-10 with Adam optimizer and SparseCategoricalCrossentropy loss
